skills.name: acd-cad-determinism-probe
skills.description: Measure whether STEP and 3MF exports from the CAD kernel are byte-identical across runs and which normalization rule makes them comparable. Use when investigating CAD output hashes or updating build123d / cadquery-ocp.

skills.name: acd-contracts
skills.description: How to read and validate ACD Pydantic contracts in this workspace. Use when creating or checking ACD documents.

skills.name: acd-design-knowledge
skills.description: Answer product, usage, troubleshooting, rationale and history questions from the indexed design knowledge with source citations.

skills.name: acd-design-rationale
skills.description: Record and validate typed design rationale for adopted ACD values.

skills.name: acd-firmware-esp32c3
skills.description: Develop, build and virtually run ESP32-C3 (ESP-IDF) firmware for an ACD design, with a pin-consistency check against the design graph. Use when firmware work is part of an ACD design task.

skills.name: acd-install-doctor
skills.description: Check whether the ACD plugin was installed correctly and report runtime and host capability observations. Use after ACD installation or when checking the Local GUI environment.

skills.name: acd-placement-search
skills.description: Search deterministic component placements (position and rotation) for an ACD board and rank candidates with surrogate metrics. Use when a board needs placements before the KiCad projection and the ERC/DRC gates.

skills.name: acd-product-docs
skills.description: Generate deterministic product description and instruction manual documents from the design graph and recorded projections.

skills.name: acd-qc-seven-tools
skills.description: Apply QC seven tools (Q7) and new QC seven tools (N7) to ACD design findings — Pareto ranking, stratification, cause candidates, tree and matrix diagrams. Use when organizing ERC/DRC, DFM, review, or measurement findings before deciding what to fix first.

skills.name: acd-reliability-review
skills.description: Screen a design against reliability practices — derating and part stress analysis, worst-case analysis, single point of failure review, and evidence validity. Use when reviewing margins before ordering or when a rule table's validity domain is in question.

skills.name: acd-silkscreen-placement
skills.description: Resolve silkscreen label positions for an ACD board by deterministic perimeter search, recording accepted and rejected candidates as evidence. Use when functional labels must be positioned before the board projection and DRC.

skills.name: acd-theme-song
skills.description: Compose a product theme song (jingle) for a design graph as a Standard MIDI File. The agent writes a theme song proposal JSON (key, tempo, tracks, notes, drums); the Skill validates it strictly and renders MIDI, falling back to a deterministic graph-derived song when no proposal exists.

skills.name: acd:ask
skills.description: Answer a design question from the indexed design knowledge with source citations.

skills.name: acd:doctor
skills.description: Diagnose ACD plugin installation integrity and local runtime capabilities.

skills.name: acd:gates
skills.description: Run the deterministic ACD electrical and mechanical gates.

skills.name: acd:init
skills.description: Initialize an ACD workspace and record its prepared revision.

skills.name: acd:vibebb-loop
skills.description: 要件から設計反復と発注可否までを固定順序で実行するVibeBB loop。

skills.name: acd:vibebb-recover
skills.description: 却下されたlaneを宣言由来の復帰次元でbounded反復するVibeBB復帰loop。
